definitions.explanation: use; purpose; application; way to use something

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{使|つか}い{道|みち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{余|あま}った→余る：00001_amaru⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い{道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To think about how to use the leftover money.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{使|つか}い{道|みち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{捨|す}てた→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: I threw away this material because I had no use for it.

notes:
{使|つか}い{道|みち} combines the stem of ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use) with ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (way, path), meaning "a purpose or application for something."

Contrast with ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧:
- ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧: HOW to use something (method/technique)
- {使|つか}い{道|みち}: WHAT to use something for (purpose/application)

Common expressions:
- {使|つか}い{道|みち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a use)
- {使|つか}い{道|みち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no use)
- {使|つか}い{道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧ (to find a use)

The ~⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ pattern appears in other compounds:
- ⟦{逃|に}げ{道|みち}→逃げ道：27610_nigemichi⟧ (escape route)
- ⟦{生|い}き→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (way of living)
